evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds and the extraction is watched by polling a cursor

No blocking
call, and no lost work if the client drops the receipt.

observations.why: The passage sets matched operational clauses against explicit negations, especially blocking versus no lost work.

evidence.quote:
remember dispatches, then the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call.

observations.why: The sentence organizes alternatives in a matched sequence: dispatch first, then one of two follow-up paths.
